title: Floor Refinishing Services
description: The U.S. Coast Guard Academy, New London, Connecticut, intends to procure hardwood basketball court floor refinishing services. The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, transportation, and incidental services necessary to perform annual screen-and-recoat maintenance for the approximately 17,422-square-foot Roland Hall Gymnasium court and, when included and funded, biennial services for the approximately 12,129-square-foot Billard Hall Gymnasium court. Services include cleaning, mechanically screening or abrading the existing finish as necessary, removing dust and debris, and applying an approved high-solids, low-VOC, oil-based commercial athletic-floor finish compatible with the existing coating system. Base CLIN services are limited to screen-and-recoat maintenance and do not include sanding to bare wood, repainting or restoration of court markings unless damaged by the Contractor or repairs other than repairs necessary to correct Contractor-caused damage. The requirement also includes an optional, firm-fixed-price per-square-foot CLIN for full refinishing of additional Government hardwood-floor areas, if authorized. The contractor shall protect existing court markings and Government property, comply with applicable safety and environmental requirements, coordinate the work schedule with the Contracting Officer’s Representative, and return each court to a clean, safe, uniform, and playable condition.
